chapter_title_en: The Grand Sale and the Hidden Sister
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 293: Ji Ning Sells Treasures, Meets a Royal Sister
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning liquidates his Wu Jiang Immortal Estate loot for 2.6 million catties of Primordial Liquid. Meanwhile, a Xiamang princess learns of his arrival and mobilizes the Imperial Guard.
og_title: Ji Ning’s Biggest Payday Yet – and a Sister with an Army
og_description: A treasure sale worth millions, a Xia medallion earned, and a tearful royal sister who swears to protect Ji Ning from the Shaoyan clan.
twitter_title: Ji Ning is now rich, and his sister is a princess with an Imperial Guard.
twitter_description: A massive treasure liquidation, a VIP medallion, and a long-lost relative who’s ready to throw down for Ji Ning. Chapter 293 delivers.

lore_anchors.definition: The premier trading organization of the Grand Xia Dynasty, acting as a marketplace and auction house for cultivators of all levels.
The lowest grade of classified magic treasure, suitable for Zifu and Wanxiang-level cultivators.
A mid-grade magic treasure, more powerful than Human-ranked, often used by Wanxiang Adepts.
A high-grade magic treasure, often crafted by Immortals, possessing great power and rare properties.
The highest tier of common magic treasure, usually wielded by Celestial Immortals; extremely rare in the Wanxiang Adept tier.
A VIP token from Heavenly Treasures Mountain that grants its holder a permanent 40% discount on all purchases, normally reserved for Earth Immortals and Loose Immortals.
A monthly high-stakes auction held at Heavenly Treasures Mountain where rare and powerful items can appear.
An elite military force of the Grand Xia Dynasty's imperial capital, serving directly under the royal clan.
The royal clan of the Grand Xia Dynasty, rulers of this major world for countless ages.
